purpose: Repository-owned source-of-truth index for KIBER robot-card production rules.

unitree_g1_visual_review_2026_09_18.applies_to: robot-card rewrite workflow unless later testing changes it
summary: Hero and top gallery stay as-is for now
AI summary keeps approximate length but renders as two paragraphs
Shared service/order blocks must be checked against robot-specific use
Capabilities need real 2–3 line lead, shorter descriptions, and full useful image presentation without ugly cropping
Scenarios may use SEO-enriched headings only if natural and visually manageable; descriptions can be shortened 20–30%
Robot-in-action heading must be individual to the robot/gallery, not fixed generic copy
Gosha pattern stays as-is unless specifically requested
Blog block uses 3 relevant article cards
Related catalog uses 4 relevant robots with useful variety when possible

media_alt_policy.rule: Public alt is derived from actualDescription/checked seoAlt, not blindly from sourceAlt.
media_alt_policy.distribution: roughly every second meaningful image may carry natural commercial/long-tail SEO context when visually truthful; do not optimize every image
media_alt_policy.seo_map_policy: main SEO map may show compact media-alt status/evidence fields, while full alt inventories stay in media source files or media review pages
